# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V4002 unreachable_arm"
description: "A match arm can never be reached because earlier arms already cover every value it matches."
---

An error from the `pattern` phase. `sakura explain V4002` prints this explanation offline.

A `match` arm can never be reached because earlier arms already cover every value it matches.
Remove it, or move it before the arm that shadows it.

Wrong:

```sakura
match o { _ => 0, Some(n) => n }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
match o { Some(n) => n, _ => 0 }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V4002_unreachable_arm.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V4002_unreachable_arm.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn sign(n: Int) -> String {
  match n {
    0 => "zero",
    _ => "nonzero",
    1 => "one",
  }
}
```

## Fixed program
